SoF Tracker 1.50.0: the Android app

- SoF Tracker for Android: get the tracker's alerts as notifications on your phone, also away from home, and the live phone page on your home Wi-Fi. Pair it with Settings → Phone app (scan the QR code).
- Option to send alerts only while you're away (game closed or AFK); urgent ones always go.
- New switch "Let my phone see the tracker on this Wi-Fi" in Settings → Phone app.

Install the app: download SoF-Tracker-Android-1.50.0.apk below on your phone and open it.

SoF Tracker 1.49.0

- Potion and ginseng counts on the hotbar are read correctly, including 4-digit counts (e.g. 1553 and 2248; "2248" used to be read as "748").
- Counts the reader is unsure about are left out instead of shown as a wrong number.

SoF Tracker 1.48.0

- Potions and ginseng on the hotbar: the screen reader recognises their icons on the 1-0 and F1-F10 rows and reads the count in the corner. Per character: how many are left, use per hour of play, about how long they last, and how long earlier batches lasted.
- An alert when one drops below a limit you choose (default 50, Stats > Potions & ginseng). Also shown on the Live tab, the overlay and the phone page.

SoF Tracker 1.47.0

- Real-time HP / MP / EXP bars: Settings > Screen reader > "HP / MP / EXP bars" reads the bars 2, 5, 10 or 20 times a second between full reads (by colour, a few milliseconds each). The dashboard, overlay, phone page and widgets update live, and the low-HP alert reacts within a fraction of a second.
- Full reads can now run every 1 second, or with no pause at all.

SHA-256 of SoF-Tracker-Setup-1.47.0.exe:

SoF Tracker 1.46.0

- Potions per character, read from each character's own setup in the game folder.
- Skill setup panel (Stats tab): skill bar, auto-combat setup and cooldowns, plus stronger skills you can learn now.
- Your own characters are recognised: alts are no longer counted as players met or as danger.
- Game settings check: windowed mode and chat background in the Setup check, and graphics advice when the game freezes.
- Game setting changes are shown on the session timeline.
